_note: BREAKOUT_CONTINUATION v1 revalidation config. Single official config: S_full_trend_htf (winning combo from 2026-05-12 audit sweep). No parameter sweep, no reconciliation against trade-level legacy (legacy CSV is aggregate-only — sweep stats, not trades). Strategy spec frozen from my-strategy/research/experimental/xauusd_4h_long_breakout_continuation_regime_filtered.md + my-strategy/pine_alerts/01_xauusd_4h_breakout_continuation.pine.

signal.summary: Triggers: close>swing_high(10)[1] AND close>open AND body_pct>=0.5 AND rsi(14)>rsi_ma. Filters (all required): ADX(14)>=20 AND close>EMA(200) AND EMA(50)>EMA(200) AND EMA(50)_now>EMA(50)_5bars_ago AND ATR(14)>SMA(ATR14,20). Sanity: low-0.5*ATR yields positive risk and risk<=5*ATR.

stop.rule: structural: stop = low_signal_bar - 0.5 * atr14_wilder; sanity: 0 < risk <= 5*atr14_wilder

trade_generation.episode_definition: Signal episode is single bar (no episode aggregation); no-overlap enforced by skipping signals whose bar <= last_exit_bar

reconciliation.on_reproduction_failure: n/a — comparison is aggregate vs aggregate only

right_censoring.policy: mark right_censored=true when exit_reason=time_limit AND exit_bar==entry_bar+time_limit_bars-1

decision_gates.note: Loose gates — purpose of v1 is to make trades.jsonl plotable for visual auction-theory review, not to bless promotion. Promotion gates set elsewhere if/when this passes visual.

strategy_specific.be_move_rule: When highs from entry_bar onwards reach entry + 1*risk on any prior bar, move stop to entry for subsequent bars (no lookahead within the bar where the +1R cross happens — move applies on the NEXT bar's stop check).
